Description
These Sunshine coins are some of the most interesting to come onto the market in recent years. They are uncirculated and have no denomination noted on them because they are not legal tender. In essence, these coins are specifically made for people who want to invest in quantities of silver but in small bundles. Each coin comes with a troy ounce of silver that has a purity of .999 fine silver. That makes these coins perfect for buying in bulk, or just a few dozen to help you build a hedge against the market inflation.
The obverse side of the coin shows an eagle in flight and the sun in the background with stunning detail along with the words SUNSHINE MINTING. The reverse side of the coin shows the mint stamp as well as the weight and purity of each coin that has been minted. Overall, this coin has a great market value for people who are interested in investing in silver, and also represents a great chance to improve a coin collection or start one for a member of your family or a friend.
